title: Aliens call humans water beings

tellings.quote: >> He always referred to us as water vessels or water beings, water humans.

plain: A non-human being once referred to people as "water vessels or water beings, water humans," according to Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens. Sherman tells Michels this happened in his own work between 1990 and 1993, at a site he calls Base 2, and says the being "always" used those words for us, a sign of how it saw humans: as creatures made mostly of water.
